# Dough Intent Coverage: Cursor runner lifecycle on Vitest

Verdict: **Caught.**

## Target
- Story: .planning/seeds/SEED-413-renovate-dashboard-unit-tests.md#prove-cursor-runner-lifecycle-on-vitest; plan .planning/slice-plans/873-prove-cursor-runner-lifecycle-on-vitest/PLAN.md (slice 1).
- Revision: 2cbce0d9589544f04b600d306a3fcb9c77ebb20f (claude/prove-cursor-runner-lifecycle-in-node-vitest).
- Promise: "a wrong or absent proof on an answering runner requires one replacement before exec." Expected observable behavior: new Cursor work against an answering runner with stale/absent build proof stops it, spawns a current-build runner, and exec answers with the agent session id.
- Fault (caller suggestion validated and used unchanged): in dashboard/server/hosts/cursor/runnerCurrent.ts, ensureCurrentCursorRunnerOnce, the `rechecked === false` branch under the start lock had `stopCursorRunner(home); ok = await spawnRunner(home); startedOrReplaced = ok;` replaced by a single `console.error("IC-WITNESS ... replacement skipped")` line. No fixtures or assertions changed.
- Command (caller suggestion, used unchanged): `caffeinate -s -i env -u GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES -u OPEN_DOUGH_DASHBOARD_BACKEND_SPLIT -u FORCE_COLOR -u NO_COLOR npm run test:dashboard:backend -- '(sessions/cursor-runner-(build-proof|current-proof))\.spec\.ts$' --workers=1`

## Evidence
- Scratch checkout: detached worktree at the revision under /Users/terryyin/.claude/jobs/3c413643/tmp/ic/scratch, fresh `npm ci` (Node 24.21.0), clean pre-probe state (0 changed tracked files). The execution worktree was not edited. Scratch worktree removed afterwards.
- Baseline: 10/10 passed (Vitest 5.1.0), including the four replacement cases.
- Faulted run: exit 1, 4 failed / 6 passed.
  - Reach and wrong behavior (independent witness): the IC-WITNESS line printed once in each of the four failing cases, proving the stale-but-answering path under the start lock was reached and replacement skipped; exec then returned `undefined` instead of an answer (no replacement, no agent session).
  - Catching assertions:
    - dashboard/backend-tests/sessions/cursor-runner-build-proof.spec.ts:39 `expect(created).toMatchObject({ failed: false, stdout: ... })` in "a stand-in runner with wrong build proof is replaced before exec answers" and the "missing build proof" variant (the wrong/absent proof cases of the promise).
    - cursor-runner-build-proof.spec.ts:72 `expect(first).toMatchObject({ failed: false })` in "a real runner whose recorded proof turns stale while holding a client is replaced once before new work" (the planning probe's case; same undefined exec as plan premise row 4).
    - dashboard/backend-tests/sessions/cursor-runner-current-proof.spec.ts:134 `expect(created).toMatchObject(...)` in "a runner whose recorded build proof is stale is left by start-if-absent and replaced before the next launch".
  - Unaffected as expected: the non-answering-process, unrelated-pid, pure decision (runnerBuildProofDecision) and build-identity cases still passed; the pure decision test alone would not catch this fault, the integration cases do.
- Restoration: an EXIT trap ran `git checkout` on the file; afterwards `git diff` empty, HEAD still 2cbce0d95, `git status --porcelain` empty; the same command rerun passed 10/10 with no IC-WITNESS output.
- Claim bound: the catch covers the replacement branch under the start lock on the stand-in (wrong/missing proof), real-runner stale-proof, and start-if-absent-then-launch paths. Not probed: the lock-contention branch (another starter replaced) or the deadline fallback.
- Machine load: 1-min load ~6.7-7.9 (5-min ~13, 15-min ~19) during runs, lower than the 20-35 the caller reported.

## Next proof action
None needed for this promise; maintained Vitest proof catches the fault. This matches plan Decisive premises row 4 (recognition of the planned premise, not a new repair decision).
